releases.name: Fashionocalypse 2026-11-15
releases.body: Created Fashionocalypse, a containment game about clothes that never go away. You play the global textile authority and keep ten fashion brands inside their home regions on a spinning globe. Spend Capital on world wide laws or target one brand, and tap support drops to earn more. Win by keeping every brand contained for two years or by reaching 2050 under the contamination limit.

jobs.description: A containment game where you keep ten fashion brands inside their home regions on a globe.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-15
releases.body: Added a Sites tab that puts the RTSS and RDSS survey sites on the map, with the surveys, visit log, stops, notes and photos for each place. RTSS and RDSS now open inside Field Twin and share site details. A Field Twin account works in both survey tools, and the survey server records who saved. A color key now drops down, there is a new Dash cam tab, and an RTSS and RDSS switch sits above the surveys.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-16
releases.body: Added Tickets. Scan ticket screen reads work tickets from a photo of the work phone, a check screen fixes misreads and picks the locker, and each open ticket shows on the map as a countdown ring. Best next and the fork card rank stops by SLA slack after drive time, and closes inside SLA earn points. The receipt and ticket readers now share one photo reader that falls back through newer models, and Service check shows the reader key and the last reader error.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

releases.name: Delivery Twin 2026-11-15
releases.body: Added direction chevrons on the delivery lines. Added links that open the RTSS and RDSS site surveys.

jobs.description: A phone friendly field log with a map, receipts, and mileage, now with a food spots layer.

releases.name: RIE API 2026-11-15
releases.body: Calls can carry the Field Twin account key. The server checks it with the account service and records which account created and last saved each site, survey and design. Calls without a key still work. A new /me route says which account a key belongs to.

jobs.description: Backend that stores restaurant site surveys and shared site profiles.

releases.name: RTSS 2026-11-15
releases.body: Rebuilt as version 3 with a light theme and a survey that saves one document per site, with a phone copy for offline work. Old saves carry over on first open. Added a Drive-thru tab with a 3D lane and equipment model, sun and shade by time of day, screen heat estimates, car stack, cable runs and photos. The Topology, Integration and Cabling tabs were rebuilt. An apps menu links RTSS, RDSS and Field Twin for the same site, and Notes has a visit log. RTSS now opens inside Field Twin and shares site details, and a Field Twin account records who saved.

jobs.description: Restaurant technology site survey form with cloud sync and CSV export.

releases.name: Restaurant Design and Setup Survey 2026-11-15
releases.body: Rebuilt as version 3 in the RTSS style, with a light theme, drop down cards, and Build, Survey, Demo and More tabs. A shared apps menu and site links were added. It saves one document per site with a phone copy, and old saves carry over on first open. It now opens inside Field Twin, shares site details with RTSS, and a Field Twin account records who saved.

jobs.description: Survey tool for designing and scoring a restaurant concept, with sample concepts and a summary export.

releases.name: MobbyHill 2026-11-15
releases.body: Added fore and aft lean, stickier suspension, garage upgrades, and sand, mud, water and boulders on the hill. Added a mode menu with fuel and hill climb modes, a ghost of your best run, and a damage mode with repairs. Tokens are now a second currency. A weekly wallet fills from the server, and parts can be paid in cash or tokens.

jobs.description: A wireframe off road hill climb for the phone with tilt steering and score hub scores.

releases.name: Score Hub 2026-11-15
releases.body: Registered three more MobbyHill modes: Fuel, Climb and Climb Fuel. The climb modes post height in tenths of a meter and the hub shows them in meters. Added weekly token wallets that games spend through the server. MobbyHill is the first game with one, at 1000 tokens a week, holding up to 3000.

jobs.description: A shared score service and hub page for the games

releases.name: App Index 2026-11-16
releases.body: Added a Railway tab that lists every Railway project and service with this billing period cost, an end of period estimate, deploy status, and idle flags. Apps with a Railway backend get a blue railway button that opens it in Railway. Hire Portal got its orange phone star.

jobs.description: An index page that lists every app with its age, phone tags, and notes.

releases.name: Pajamastan 2026-11-16
releases.body: Added the Hire Portal to the Links tab as a Pajamastan portal.

jobs.description: The official site of the micronation of Pajamastan.

releases.name: Hire Portal 2026-11-16
releases.body: Fixed the spelling of the company name. The portal is now a Pajamastan portal, with a blue Republic of Pajamastan link at the top that goes back to the Pajamastan site.

jobs.description: A practice job application that teaches applicants what to share and what to withhold

releases.name: Stackloom 2026-11-15
releases.body: Added the Match line, the candy smashing match three game. Swipe a piece into its neighbor to line up three or more, clear the goal before the moves run out, and chain cascades for combos. Opened by hiring a level designer once a puzzle designer is on staff. Nine skins, five or six pieces, generous or tight moves, and premium art. Sucker Smash joins the studio samples.

jobs.description: A studio game with orders, terminals, agents, developers, and offices.
